image_description: A close-up photograph showing a pair of human hands gently holding a small, slender snake. The snake has a smooth, glossy body with pinkish-brown to reddish coloration on its dorsal side and a lighter, pale underside. The head is small and rounded, blending seamlessly into the body, while the tail tapers to a blunt point. The background is blurred, focusing attention on the interaction between the hands and the reptile.
